description: This file defines kernel packages and their properties related to Freescale QorIQ AHCI SATA support and Freescale PPFE Driver support within the Linux kernel build system.

methods.name: define KernelPackage/ahci-qoriq
methods.description: Defines the kernel package for Freescale QorIQ AHCI SATA support, including its menu position, title, configuration option, file dependencies, and auto-loading behavior.

methods.name: define KernelPackage/ahci-qoriq/description
methods.description: Provides the description for the AHCI QorIQ package, explaining its purpose.

methods.name: define KernelPackage/ppfe
methods.description: Defines the kernel package for Freescale PPFE Driver support, specifying menu position, title, dependencies, configuration options, file path, and auto-loading.

methods.name: define KernelPackage/ppfe/description
methods.description: Provides the description for the PPFE driver package.
